item.title: Version 1.0.12
item.changes: Grade: brightness for shadows, midtones and highlights, and an eye to switch a clip's grade off and on. Transcription: choose the speech language in Settings › General, and you're told when a language can't be transcribed. Timeline: Option-dragging a clip to copy it now snaps to the original. Smoother with big projects: importing lots of media at once no longer slows playback and export. Settings and captions: tidier layout, with section titles that scroll and matching eye toggles.
